name: PyVista Volume Processing
description: Volumetric and grid processing via PyVista: isosurface extraction (contouring), slicing, thresholding, geometry extraction, and cell filtering.

videos.title: Mesh, Voxels & Volumes: Binary Erosion and Marching Cubes

theory.overview:
PyVista volume processing wraps VTK filters for extracting information from volumetric and grid datasets:

**Contour/Isosurface** extracts surfaces at scalar isovalues using marching cubes.
**Slice** creates a cross-section along any plane.
**Threshold** selects cells within a scalar range.
**Extract Geometry** converts a volume to its surface representation.
**Extract Cells** selects cells by type.

pv_contour.title: Isosurface Contour
pv_contour.content: Marching cubes extracts a surface mesh at scalar isovalue $c$: $\{\mathbf{x} : f(\mathbf{x}) = c\}$.

pv_slice.title: Slice
pv_slice.content: Intersects the dataset with a plane $\mathbf{n} \cdot (\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{o}) = 0$ to produce a cross-section.

pv_slice_orthogonal.title: Orthogonal Slices
pv_slice_orthogonal.content: Creates three orthogonal slices through the dataset at specified X, Y, Z positions.

pv_threshold_volume.title: Volume Threshold
pv_threshold_volume.content: Selects cells with scalar values in $[l, u]$, preserving the volumetric structure.

pv_extract_geometry.title: Extract Geometry
pv_extract_geometry.content: Extracts the boundary surface of a volume as a polygonal mesh.

pv_extract_cells.title: Extract Cells by Type
pv_extract_cells.content: Selects cells matching a specified cell type (tetrahedral, hexahedral, etc.).

parameters.description: Preserve the contoured scalar on the output.

parameters.description: Generate contour edges of the slice.

parameters.description: X position for YZ slice (0 = center).

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y position for XZ slice (0 = center).

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Z position for XY slice (0 = center).

parameters.name: contour
parameters.description: Generate contour edges of the slices.

parameters.name: continuous
parameters.description: Use continuous cell range for thresholding.

parameters.name: all_scalars
parameters.description: Require all scalar components to satisfy the range.

parameters.name: cell_type
parameters.description: Cell type to extract: tetrahedral, hexahedral, wedge, pyramid, triangle, quad.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.description: Invert selection (extract all cells NOT of this type).
